name: trusted_pegasus_only_the_target_gains_flying
notes: G3 (target->all at 1/0/effect/args/target). Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, target attacking creature without flying gains flying until end of turn.' One target, not every attacker. Pegasus, Bear and Giant attack; the trigger targets the Bear. The Bear flies; the Giant, another attacking creature without flying, does not, so P1's non-flying Ogre may block the Giant only. Damage: Giant 4 to the Ogre, Ogre 2 to the Giant; P1 takes 2 (Pegasus) + 2 (Bear).
